ipeds.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Alabama State University (fall 2024 admissions, test scores, enrollment, 2024-25 costs)

ipeds_api.title: NCES IPEDS fall 2024 admissions and fall enrollment counts (Urban Institute Education Data Portal)

stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024): percentages from College Navigator, exact counts from the NCES file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal. Alabama State's institutional data page links Common Data Sets only through 2021-2022, so no Common Data Set is used, and international applicants and admits, GPA, SAT total and admission factors are not shown. College Navigator prints 98% admitted. SAT/ACT ranges cover enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (SAT 1%, ACT 34%), so the SAT range rests on very few students; no 50th percentiles are printed. Undergraduate enrollment 3,521 and nonresident-alien undergraduates 87 are IPEDS fall 2024 enrollment.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance for Alabama residents ($32,384 total at the out-of-state tuition rate). The university's tuition page for 2024-25 prints $11,068 in-state / $19,936 out-of-state tuition and fees; international students pay the out-of-state rate
